summary: Cheniere Energy Partners, L.P. filed an 8-K solely to declare a quarterly cash distribution of $0.820 per common unit (comprising $0.775 base and $0.045 variable) payable on August 14, 2026 to unitholders of record as of August 7, 2026. The filing includes a press release and discusses US withholding tax implications for foreign investors. No merger, acquisition, tender, restructuring, or other special situation is announced. This is a routine distribution declaration, not a special-situations event.
